title: command palette can't find portable apps

judgment.rationale: The latest report distinguishes All Apps discovery from Start search and from the full-path file-search fallback. Current source retains the custom ProgramSources enumeration path but does not register a user-facing ProgramSources editor in the All Apps settings list. The issue is actively assigned, so preserve the owner and do not propose competing work.
evidence: The issue is open and assigned to jiripolasek; labels include Help Wanted and Needs-Team-Response.
The 2026-09-30 report says a portable executable in an indexed custom folder appears in Start search but not All Apps, while typing its full executable name reaches file search.

At PowerToys main 2d28a562bfb5f8a76c4a43bbd8c3939f827bb368, Win32Program.cs calls CustomProgramPaths(settings.ProgramSources, settings.ProgramSuffixes) at line 970; AllAppsSettings.cs exposes ProgramSources at line 49 but its Settings collection registers only toggles at lines 164-172.
judgment.recommended_action: Defer independent fix work to the assigned maintainer and re-evaluate if ownership or substantive discussion changes.

fix_assessment.rationale: An active upstream assignee owns the issue; this update does not create a competing fix proposal.
